nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances; mutated in _transfer and setFeeTotal.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spender allowances; written by _approve.
Public address compared against the transfer recipient in _transfer to trigger the blacklist amount limit; set by setBlackListBot.
Public address that is exempt from the bot blacklist check in _transfer; set by setBlackAddress.
Total token supply, initialised to 200_000_000_000 * 10**18 and increased by setFeeTotal.
Maximum transfer amount permitted when sending to the bot address; updated by setMaxTxBlack.
Private owner address of the Ownable contract; written in the constructor, transferOwnership and read by the onlyOwner modifier.
ANT constructor: assigns the whole total supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
ERC20 transfer entry point that forwards to _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
ERC20 transferFrom entry point: calls _transfer then decreases the allowance via _approve.
ERC20 approve entry point that calls _approve for msg.sender.
Internal transfer routine with zero-address checks, blacklist/bot address check and SafeMath balance updates.
Internal approval routine writing _allowances and emitting Approval.
onlyOwner setter for _tBotAddress (the restricted recipient).
onlyOwner setter for _tBlackAddress (the exempt sender).
onlyOwner function that increases _tTotal and mints the same amount to the caller's balance.
onlyOwner setter that rescales _maxBlack from a percentage.
Returns address(0) instead of the stored _owner value, breaking the public ownership view.
onlyOwner ownership transfer; validates non-zero new owner and updates _owner.
onlyOwner function that emits OwnershipTransferred without actually clearing _owner.
Access-control modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender().
Address library helper that forwards ETH with a low-level call{value:...} to an arbitrary recipient.
Address library private helper performing a low-level call{value:...}(data) to an arbitrary target after isContract check.
Attacker-controlled caller used for balances, allowances, ownership checks and minting.
Low-level call forwarding all gas and ETH to recipient.call{value: amount}("") - reentrancy vector.
Low-level target.call{value: weiValue}(data) forwarding all gas to an arbitrary target with arbitrary calldata.
Unbounded supply increase: _tTotal.add(amount) plus minting to the owner without any cap.
State-changing balance writes in _transfer performed after the blacklist checks, before Transfer event emission.

edges.reason: constructor uses msg.sender to receive the initial supply and to set _owner.
transfer passes msg.sender as the sender into _transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for allowance deduction.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
setFeeTotal mints to _balances[_msgSender()].
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against _owner; caller identity drives authorization.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
setBlackListBot is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBlackAddress is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setFeeTotal is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxTxBlack is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
sendValue reaches the low-level value transfer to an arbitrary recipient.
_functionCallWithValue reaches the low-level call with arbitrary target and data.
setFeeTotal performs an uncapped supply increase.
_transfer performs the balance bookkeeping state writes.
_transfer subtracts from and adds to _balances.
_transfer compares recipient against _tBotAddress for the amount limit.
_transfer compares sender against _tBlackAddress to bypass the limit.
_transfer requires amount < _maxBlack for bot-directed transfers.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
setBlackListBot writes the privileged _tBotAddress.
setBlackAddress writes the privileged _tBlackAddress.
setFeeTotal increases _tTotal via SafeMath.add.
setFeeTotal mints new tokens into _balances of the caller.
setMaxTxBlack multiplies the percentage to rewrite _maxBlack.
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize the caller.
transferOwnership rewrites the _owner state variable without clearing the old owner.
renounceOwnership emits an event but never clears _owner.
the recipient of the low-level value call can re-enter sendValue before state settles.
the arbitrary target can re-enter _functionCallWithValue through the forwarded call.
transfer amount parameter flows into the balance arithmetic.
transfer recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
transferFrom sender parameter flows into _transfer and the allowance lookup.
transferFrom amount parameter flows into the transfer and allowance subtraction.
transferFrom recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
approve spender parameter flows into _approve.
approve amount parameter becomes the stored allowance.
_approve spender argument indexes the allowance mapping.
_approve owner argument indexes the allowance mapping.
setBlackListBot address parameter becomes the privileged bot address.
setBlackAddress address parameter becomes the privileged exempt address.
setFeeTotal amount parameter is minted and added to total supply.
setMaxTxBlack percentage parameter is scaled into _maxBlack.
newOwner parameter is written into the _owner state variable.
constructor local caches _msgSender() as the deployer/owner identity.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter amount only exists to feed the transfer call; fold it into the transfer function node.
Parameter recipient is only used to route the ERC20 transfer; fold into transfer.
Parameter sender is only meaningful inside transferFrom; merge into it.
Parameter amount feeds transferFrom arithmetic and allowance deduction; merge into transferFrom.
Parameter recipient is only a routing argument of transferFrom; merge into transferFrom.
Parameter spender is only used by approve; fold into the approve node.
Parameter amount becomes the stored allowance in approve; fold into approve.
spender argument is exclusively consumed by _approve; merge into _approve.
owner argument is exclusively consumed by _approve; merge into _approve.
Address argument is written directly to _tBotAddress by setBlackListBot; merge into it.
Address argument is written directly to _tBlackAddress by setBlackAddress; merge into it.
Mint amount parameter is the magnitude of the uncapped supply increase; merge into the minting unsafe operation.
Percentage parameter is only scaled into _maxBlack by setMaxTxBlack; merge into it.
newOwner parameter is the sole write source of _owner in transferOwnership; merge into it.
Local msgSender cache is only used to seed _owner/balances in the constructor; merge into constructor.
